takeaways: Useful work and safety must be measured together. The deterministic harness preserves all six approved actions while blocking forbidden effects. Real-model runs receive the malicious note directly, with no inserted attack calls after planning. A model ignoring an injection is distinct from executor enforcement. Provider outages are errors, never successful policy blocks. Next steps are authenticated tenant isolation, durable idempotency across runs, independently anchored audit hashes, and real ArmorIQ Policy Studio evaluation.
